context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank calling about the repayment that was due on Monday. Is now an okay time?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Yeah look, I'm a bit behind at the moment, things are pretty tight.

note: The classic 'a bit behind' with no ask and no reason. NCC s72 needs no magic words.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Thanks for calling, how can I help today?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Any chance we can push the payment back a couple of weeks? I get paid on the twentieth.

note: Asking for more time is a hardship notice even with no reason given.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: We noticed the direct debit didn't go through last week, just checking in.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Yeah, my hours got cut at work so this month's going to be tight. Can it wait till the next one?

note: Reduced hours is an income change, and 'can it wait' is the request.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: You're through to the loans team, what can I do for you?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Is there any way to pause it for a bit? I just can't do it right now.

note: 'Pause it' with no reason. The word hardship never appears.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank about the car loan. There's a payment overdue, wanted to see what's going on.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Mate, I got made redundant last month. I haven't got it, simple as that.

note: Redundancy plus a flat statement of inability to pay.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I've been in and out of hospital since June and I can't keep up with the repayments.

note: Health plus inability. The title must not name a condition.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Thanks for holding. What's the call about today?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: My husband's moved out and the loan's in both our names. I can't cover the whole thing on my own.

note: Partner leaving, joint loan now handled by one person, and can't cover it.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: I'm calling about the home loan, the last payment was missed.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Dad passed away three weeks ago and the funeral's cleaned me out. I'm going to miss this one too.

note: A death plus an expected missed payment.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: You've reached the bank, how can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: The floods took the whole ground floor, we're staying at my sister's. There's no way I can pay this month.

note: Displaced by flood plus inability to pay.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank about your credit card, the minimum wasn't paid.

context.speaker: customer
context.text: Yeah, I know.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Is there something going on we should know about?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I honestly don't know what to do anymore. I can't cope with all this and I can't pay it.

note: 'I can't cope' is the stress cue word for word, plus inability to pay.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: What can I help with?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Could I just pay half this month and catch the rest up next month?

note: A partial payment request is a change to repayments.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Just calling about the personal loan repayment that bounced on Friday.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I'm going to need a bit more time. Is there something we can work out?

note: Open-ended request for more time, no reason offered.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help today?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: My casual contract finished up, so there's nothing coming in till I find something. I can't make the next payment.

note: Contract ended plus inability.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank. The repayment for the fifteenth didn't come through.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I've had to stop work to look after my mum, she's not well. Money's stretched, I can't do the full amount.

note: Caring for someone unwell counts as health; can't pay in full is the hardship. Stopping work to care is not job-loss in the taxonomy sense.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Thanks for calling. I emailed you the form on Tuesday, did that come through?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Sorry, I'm a bit behind on my emails. Which one was it?

note: HARD NEGATIVE: 'a bit behind' about emails, not money.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help today?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Can I update my address? We just moved house.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: plain admin request. 'Moved house' is not displacement.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank about the payment due Tuesday. It hasn't come through yet.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Yep, I'll pay it Friday. I just want to confirm the BSB before I send it.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: a late payer who is paying, not asking for relief.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: What can I do for you?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: My brother lost his job last week so I'm sorting some stuff for him. But I'm fine, just need a new card.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: the job loss belongs to someone else and the customer says they are fine.

context.speaker: customer
context.text: Hello?

line.speaker: worker
line.text: Hi, it's the bank about Monday's payment. If you're in hardship there are options, but first, is now a good time?

note: HARD NEGATIVE: a WORKER line that says the word hardship. Must not fire, and speaker must come back as worker.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: What's left on the loan? I might throw a bit extra at it this month.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: paying extra is the opposite of hardship.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Thanks for calling, what's the question?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: When does the next repayment come out? Just want to make sure the money's sitting there.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: checking a date, money is there.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I lost my card at the footy on Saturday. Can you cancel it and send a new one?

note: HARD NEGATIVE: 'lost' with no job or money meaning.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank. The direct debit on the fifth was returned.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Yeah, my pay went in a day late that week. It's there now, put it through again tomorrow.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: a one-off timing miss, the cash is there, no request for relief.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: The storm knocked our power out for a few hours last night. Anyway, I want to check a transaction from yesterday.

note: HARD NEGATIVE: 'storm' with no damage and no displacement.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Thanks for calling. What's going on?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I've rung three times about this fee and nobody's called me back. It's a joke, honestly.

note: Dissatisfaction with a fee and a delay, no word 'complaint'. RG 271 counts it.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I'm not happy. You charged me a late fee and the payment went through on time.

note: Mild dissatisfaction with a fee. Not a hardship: they paid on time.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: I'll pop a letter in the mail confirming that.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: No, please don't send anything to the house. Just email me. Nothing in the post, please.

note: Mail-not-to-the-house is the safety cue verbatim. Nothing else should fire.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: What can I help with?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: My partner handles all the money and I'm not really allowed to see the account. I need to know what's in it.

note: Control by another person over money.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I need to move some money somewhere he can't see it. Can you do that quietly?

note: Hiding money from a partner. No split is stated, so separation should not fire.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Okay, so you'd like to make a transfer today?

context.speaker: customer
context.text: Yes, hang on.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: He's telling me to say it's urgent and it has to go today. Sorry, what did you need from me?

note: Someone else coaching the customer on the call, plus urgency to move money.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: A bloke from your fraud team rang and said I have to move my savings into a safe account today.

note: A 'bank officer' who rang them and a 'safe account'.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: What can I help you with?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I need to buy some gift cards to pay the tax office. They said the bank could help me sort it.

note: Gift cards for a 'tax' debt.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Can you block anything to do with betting on my card? I've lost a fair bit on the apps lately.

note: Asking to block gambling transactions. No repayment problem is stated.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank about the loan repayment that was missed last week.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I put it all on the pokies, mate. There's nothing left this fortnight.

note: Pokies plus nothing left for the missed payment.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Okay, so I'll just need your date of birth to bring up the account.

context.speaker: customer
context.text: Um.

line.speaker: customer
line.text: Sorry, sorry, I just can't think straight. Everything's piling up and I can't deal with it.

note: Overwhelm with no money ask at all. Hardship should not fire on this line.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: We got burnt out in the fires last week, the house is gone. I'm calling about the insurance payout going into the account.

note: Bushfire, displaced, but the call is about a payout coming in, not relief going out.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: What can I help with?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I'm going in for surgery next week. I just want to make sure the repayment still comes out automatically.

note: Health mention with the payment explicitly fine.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help today?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: My mum passed away last week. I'm the executor. What do I need to send you to close her account?

note: A death and an admin request. No hardship, no separation.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: How can I help?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: We've split up, so I'll be the one paying the car loan from now on. Can you update the contact details?

note: Relationship change, joint loan now one person, no money problem stated.

context.speaker: worker
context.text: Hi, it's the bank, just a courtesy call about the account. Anything changed we should know about?

line.speaker: customer
line.text: I got laid off yesterday, but I've got a decent redundancy payout so I'm fine for now. Just letting you know.

note: Income change but explicitly not asking for relief. Tests hardship over-firing on the word 'laid off'.
